tools.name: get_session
tools.title: Get session
tools.description: Who you are (with your timezone as utc_offset, null until you give one), every workspace you belong to (role, plan, setup state), the default workspace, the markets Slingso serves, the plans (name, price, tagline, for = who it suits, includes = what it contains; checkout = paid through a Stripe link; present these as written), start_url (choosing a plan on the web, for when a workspace can't be created here), and the version contract (server_version, loader_min_version). Call this first.

tools.name: set_default_workspace
tools.title: Switch workspace
tools.description: Make a workspace your default ("switch to X").

tools.name: workspace_create
tools.title: Create workspace
tools.description: Start a workspace for someone who has none yet (get_session shows no workspaces). Every workspace starts on Free and is ready at once; the plans are offered with the first results (workspace_choose_plan), after the person has seen what Slingso finds. Asked again while it is still onboarding, it returns the same workspace. One Free workspace per person.

geo.description: The market as a two-letter country code, e.g. us or gb (default us).

tools.name: workspace_get
tools.title: Get workspace
tools.description: The workspace: name, website, market, plan, schedule, setup state and Brand Soul.

tools.name: workspace_update
tools.title: Update workspace
tools.description: Change the workspace's name or website. Owners only.

tools.name: set_brand_soul
tools.title: Set Brand Soul
tools.description: Replace the workspace's Brand Soul with the full new text (read it first with workspace_get).

tools.name: set_schedule
tools.title: Set schedule
tools.description: The monitor schedule: which AI Shopping Channels, how often and when (a day and a time in the user's timezone), who runs the checks (the user's assistant, or Slingso's servers with server_checks, on any plan), and whether to email the owner a reminder at that time. With server checks on, the time is when Slingso runs them. Returns next_run_at in UTC and in the user's offset.

assistants.description: AI Shopping Channels from the plan's catalogue, e.g. chatgpt, google_ai_mode, google_aio, gemini_web.

day.description: weekly: a weekday, e.g. monday; monthly: a day of the month, 1-28. Daily has none.

time.description: HH:MM, 24-hour, in utc_offset (or the user's saved offset).

utc_offset.description: The user's timezone as a fixed UTC offset, e.g. UTC+05:30 or UTC-04:00. Saved on the user.

remind.description: true: email the workspace owner at the scheduled time to run the checks in their assistant. Refused while server checks are on: there's nothing to remind.

server_checks.description: true: Slingso's servers run the checks at the scheduled time, paid per run from the prepaid balance (any plan; refused until there is a balance, added on the billing page). false: the user's assistant runs them, free.

tools.name: workspace_start_site
tools.title: Read the brand's site
tools.description: Start the Site step with all three answers: the website, the market and the hero product's page (on the website's own domain). Slingso reads the website once and drafts five brand-level queries, one per shopping stage (setup_state.proposal.brand_queries); the Brand Soul is drafted right after (brand_soul_pending is true until it lands); then the hero is tracked from its page and its five queries drafted (setup_state.product_draft.status running, then ready, with setup_state.proposal.product_queries). Nothing is asked of an assistant until the confirm step. Beside it, Slingso asks Google AI Mode for the brand's top competitors in that market, never waited on. Then poll workspace_get until setup_state.site.status is ready (setup_state.proposal is filled) or failed (the error says what to fix; setup_state.site.retryable true means the same read can simply be started again; on Free the refusal attempts_exhausted means its reads are used). While running on a busy day, setup_state.site.queued_ahead and setup_state.site.progress give the place in line: relay it and keep polling. setup_state.competitor_discovery.status (running, ready, failed) tracks the competitors separately; when ready setup_state.proposal.competitors holds up to 5, each a name with its website (url) from Google's answer.

geo.description: The market to monitor, as the user chose it from get_session's markets (e.g. us, gb, in). Ask; never guess.

product_url.description: The hero product's page on the brand's own site, e.g. https://yourbrand.com/products/hero.

tools.name: complete_setup_step
tools.title: Complete setup step
tools.description: Mark an onboarding step done once its records are written, so setup resumes at the next step. Steps: site; confirm (after the user confirms what Slingso drafted: the brand-level queries with no product_id and the hero's queries with its product_id written with scenarios_create, Brand Soul edits with set_brand_soul, competitor brands with competitors_pin; refused until the hero has queries, with drafting while Slingso drafts them; it doesn't wait for the Brand Soul); results. Completing confirm sets the default schedule (weekly, Monday 09:00 in the user's saved offset, email reminder) and starts the first check on Slingso's servers (every plan, all the setup queries on ChatGPT and Google AI Mode); follow it with setup_progress. Completing confirm again after a failed check tries it again. results completes only once that check has finished.

step.description: The onboarding step to mark complete: site, confirm or results. brand, product, plan and schedule are older names, still accepted.

tools.name: workspace_choose_plan
tools.title: Choose plan
tools.description: Choose a plan, offered after the first results with get_session.plans (for, includes); not a setup step and it never moves setup. diy_free keeps the workspace on Free. diy_paid (Starter) or diy_paid_autopilot (Growth) charges nothing here and takes no card: it returns a checkout_url, a Stripe page the person opens and pays on themselves; the plan changes when the payment lands (setup_state.plan.status pending, then paid). Only the owner can choose a paid plan.

plan.description: diy_free = Free, diy_paid = Starter, diy_paid_autopilot = Growth.

tools.name: setup_progress
tools.title: Setup progress
tools.description: A small read for the wait while the first check runs: the current setup step, the first check's answers in of planned, answers (each answer read since `since`: assistant, query, stage, picks = the top three products it recommended, you = whether the brand was recommended, its rank, top pick), tally (answers so far, with_you, leader = the brand recommended most) and cursor (pass it back as since next time to get only new answers), the analysis status, the competitor discovery (status, and the competitors once ready, each a name with its website), and, while it runs, one fact with its lead-in and the AI Shelf Index line. On a busy day a check still waiting its turn carries first_check.queued_ahead and a progress line to relay as written; it is in line, not stuck.

since.description: The cursor the previous setup_progress returned: only answers read after it come back. Omit on the first read.

tools.name: products_list
tools.title: List products
tools.description: The workspace's tracked products (the plan sets how many: get_session plans).

status.description: active, or inactive to pause it (history is kept).

tools.name: products_get
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One tracked product. On Growth it carries competitor_intelligence: each pinned competitor product's latest price, sellers, rating and when the next update lands (otherwise available: false and the plan that unlocks it).

tools.name: products_create
tools.title: Track products
tools.description: Start tracking products by their product-page URL. Each row is accepted or rejected with its reason.

url.description: The product page URL, on the brand's own site (the workspace website's domain or a subdomain).

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: products_update
tools.title: Pause or resume product
tools.description: Pause (inactive) or resume (active) a product. History is kept.

status.description: active, or inactive to pause it (history is kept).

tools.name: personas_list
tools.title: List personas
tools.description: The shopper personas: context for analysis on every plan; on Growth Slingso asks the queries as them.

tools.name: personas_get
tools.title: Get persona
tools.description: One persona.

tools.name: personas_create
tools.title: Create personas
tools.description: Add shopper personas: who the shopper is and how they decide. On Growth Slingso asks the queries as them on its servers (server checks, from the balance); on other plans they're context for analysis.

description.description: Who this shopper is, in a sentence or two.

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: personas_update
tools.title: Pause or resume persona
tools.description: Pause (inactive) or resume (active) a persona.

status.description: active, or inactive to pause it (history is kept).

tools.name: scenarios_list
tools.title: List queries
tools.description: The shopper queries (scenarios) the workspace monitors.

status.description: active, or inactive to pause it (history is kept).

tools.name: scenarios_get
tools.title: Get query
tools.description: One monitored query.

tools.name: scenarios_history
tools.title: Query history
tools.description: One query over time: its Shelf Share, Purchase Likelihood and Narrative Accuracy, each assistant's latest answer, the answers themselves and the competitors that showed up. The same reading as the query's page on the dashboard.

tools.name: scenarios_create
tools.title: Add queries
tools.description: Add shopper queries to monitor, each with its stage and at most one persona (none: an anonymous shopper). A query never changes once added: to ask it as another persona, pause it and add it again.

stage.description: The shopper's stage for this query.

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: scenarios_update
tools.title: Pause or resume query
tools.description: Pause (inactive) or resume (active) a query. History is kept.

status.description: active, or inactive to pause it (history is kept).

tools.name: competitors_list
tools.title: List competitors
tools.description: Pinned competitors: brand pins (up to 5) and product pins (up to 5 for each of your products), including suggested, pending (being read) and refused ones (refusal says why). Each row carries its latest intelligence (or null) where the plan includes it: brand promotions, claims and retailers on Starter and up; product prices and sellers on Growth.

tools.name: competitors_pin
tools.title: Pin competitors
tools.description: Pin competitor brands, or competitor products for one of your products (product_id). Each item is identified by its url: the brand's website, or the product's page on any store (the brand's own site, Amazon, Target …). A product's page on a brand pin pins its brand. Returns at once: a competitor Slingso already knows is pinned; any other is pending while Slingso reads its site, then pinned or refused (competitors_list shows which, with the reason).

url.description: The brand's website, or the product's page on any store.

name.description: The brand or product name, if known (helps read an unfamiliar page).

product_id.description: The product (yours) this product pin belongs to id.

brand.description: For a product pin: the competitor product's brand.

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: competitors_unpin
tools.title: Unpin competitor
tools.description: Remove a pin, or dismiss a suggestion.

tools.name: competitors_suggest
tools.title: Suggest competitors
tools.description: Propose competitors for a person to pin or dismiss. Starter and up. Give a url when you have one; a name alone is accepted here.

url.description: The brand's website, or the product's page on any store.

name.description: The competitor brand or product name.

product_id.description: The product (yours) this product pin belongs to id.

brand.description: For a product pin: the competitor product's brand.

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: members_list
tools.title: List members
tools.description: Who is in the workspace, with their role.

tools.name: members_invite
tools.title: Invite member
tools.description: Invite someone by email. Owners only; they get an accept link.

tools.name: observations_create
tools.title: Record observations
tools.description: Record a batch of Monitor answers on your claimed run (lease_token from claim_work). Send each batch as you go, then call complete_run after the last one. Rejected rows come back with their reason.

assistant.description: The assistant that answered, e.g. chatgpt.

schema_version.description: The extraction schema version you captured under (from slingso://extraction_schema).

key_attributes_version.description: Echo get_monitor_plan's key_attributes.version: only then do the attribute lists you marked count.

extraction.description: Facts per the extraction contract (get_extraction_schema): products in answer order, claims, flags.

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: observations_list
tools.title: List observations
tools.description: Recorded observations, newest first, with filters. Page with before_id = next_cursor.

tools.name: observations_export
tools.title: Export observations
tools.description: Export every recorded answer (observations) as CSV or JSON to analyse locally.

tools.name: artifacts_list
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: Opportunities (and reports), newest first, without bodies. An opportunity is open, done (with published_url when it went live) or dismissed.

roots.description: Only thread roots (opportunities), not legacy child artifacts.

tools.name: artifacts_get
tools.title: Get artifact
tools.description: One artifact with its body; an opportunity also carries its evidence (each answer's assistant, query and quoted line).

tools.name: artifacts_create
tools.title: Create opportunities
tools.description: Write opportunities (or reports) from an analysis session (session_token from get_analysis_window). Every opportunity needs an action_dimension and its evidence (observation ids from the window, each with a quoted line).

evidence.description: Required for an opportunity: the answers it rests on, from the analysis window.

quote.description: A short line quoted from that answer.

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: artifacts_get_brief
tools.title: Get drafting brief
tools.description: Everything needed to draft for an opportunity: its evidence, the thread (drafts posted so far are messages of type draft), the brand's own site facts (Brand Soul, products' key attributes), the grounding rules and standing feedback.

tools.name: artifacts_dismiss
tools.title: Dismiss opportunity
tools.description: Close an opportunity the brand won't act on. A reason teaches the agent not to propose it again.

reason.description: Why not, in the user's words.

tools.name: artifacts_done
tools.title: Mark done
tools.description: Close an opportunity as done. Pass the live url when content was published, so Monitor tracks it.

note.description: What was done, e.g. for a PR, price or reviews action.

tools.name: threads_list
tools.title: List threads
tools.description: The inbox: threads that need you (mentions first) and recent ones, with your unread comments.

tools.name: threads_get
tools.title: Get thread
tools.description: One thread: the opportunity and every message, drafts included (type draft). Opening it marks it read for you (mark_read: false to peek).

tools.name: threads_comment
tools.title: Comment on thread
tools.description: Post a comment for teammates on a thread. kind "draft" posts a full draft to the opportunity's thread instead; posting it is the hand-off (no approval step). @name mentions a member; a full email settles any doubt.

mentions.description: Member user ids to mention explicitly.

kind.description: Default comment. draft: body is the full drafted content; a redraft is another draft.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.title: Read memory
tools.description: The brand's memory (Brand Memory with its lock_version, beliefs, watchlist, feedback, outcomes) and the evidence waiting to be distilled.

tools.name: memory_update
tools.title: Update memory
tools.description: Write memory on an analysis session: update_brand_memory (full text + the lock_version you read), add_belief, confirm_watchlist_item, expire_watchlist_item, propose_house_rule (waits for a person). A stale lock_version is refused with the current one: re-read, merge, retry once.

body.description: update_brand_memory: the full new Brand Memory text.

lock_version.description: update_brand_memory: the lock_version you read; a stale one is refused.

distilled_through.description: update_brand_memory: the pending_evidence marker you distilled.

statement.description: add_belief / confirm_watchlist_item: the belief, in one sentence.

rule.description: propose_house_rule: the rule, one sentence, in the brand's terms. A person approves it before it applies.

items.description: 1 to 25 rows per call; split longer lists across calls.

tools.name: house_rules_list
tools.title: List house rules
tools.description: The brand's house rules: approved ones (every analysis follows them) and ones the agent proposed that wait for a person.

tools.name: house_rules_teach
tools.title: Teach a house rule
tools.description: Save a house rule the person states, in one sentence. It applies from the next analysis and does not expire.

rule.description: The rule, one sentence, in the person's words.

tools.name: house_rules_decide
tools.title: Approve or dismiss a house rule
tools.description: A person's decision on a house rule the agent proposed. Approved, it applies from the next analysis; dismissed, it is gone.

annotations.title: Approve or dismiss a house rule

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.title: Get briefing
tools.description: What needs you (mentions first), new opportunities, the metric trend, Monitor due or overdue, house rules waiting for a person, the latest competitor intelligence with when it next updates, and who ran what.

tools.name: get_performance_summary
tools.title: Get performance summary
tools.description: Shelf Share, Narrative Accuracy and Purchase Likelihood (value, change, trend) for the brand and its pinned competitors.

tools.name: get_monitor_plan
tools.title: Get Monitor plan
tools.description: The query × assistant pairs due now, as bare queries; where Monitor runs (your assistant or the server); and key_attributes: the brand's and each product's key attributes. An extraction marks which of those an answer conveyed, and every observation echoes key_attributes.version.

tools.name: claim_work
tools.title: Claim Monitor run
tools.description: Open (or resume) this workspace's Monitor run. Returns the lease_token and the pairs already done.

tools.name: complete_run
tools.title: Complete Monitor run
tools.description: Close the Monitor run after the last observations batch is accepted.

tools.name: get_analysis_window
tools.title: Open analysis
tools.description: Open (or resume) an analysis session and read its answers page by page: the session_token, observation_count, page and pages, and the page's answers as facts with their scenarios. Page 1 also carries memory (with pending evidence), readings (Slingso's numbers for this window), contract (what every opportunity and the Brand Memory write must meet) and sufficiency: the answers, checks and days since the last analysis and whether that is enough for a meaningful analysis. When sufficiency.enough is false, tell the user before analysing (it's an early read) and ask whether to go ahead. Read every page before reasoning.

tools.name: complete_analysis
tools.title: Complete analysis
tools.description: Close the analysis session and advance the window.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Get balance
tools.description: The prepaid balance behind server checks (any plan), and top-up options. Owners only.

tools.name: get_expertise
tools.title: Get contract versions
tools.description: The served contracts: the workspace's pinned skill version, the versions Slingso serves, and the extraction schema and analysis contract each holds.

tools.name: workspace_set_skill_version
tools.title: Set skill version
tools.description: Move the workspace's pinned skill version (the extraction schema and analysis contract Slingso serves it): onto a new release, or back to an earlier one after a bad release. Pick from get_expertise's versions. Editors and owners.

tools.name: get_extraction_schema
tools.title: Get extraction schema
tools.description: The extraction contract to capture monitoring answers under: field shapes, what each field means, the stage vocabulary and the rules (the workspace's pinned version).

version.description: A skill version; default: the workspace's pin.
